import sys
from collections import Counter

TABLE = bytes(
    c if 97 <= c <= 122 else (c + 32 if 65 <= c <= 90 else 32)
    for c in range(256)
)

def main():
    counts = Counter()
    read = sys.stdin.buffer.read
    tail = b""
    while True:
        chunk = read(4194304)
        if not chunk:
            if tail:
                counts.update(tail.translate(TABLE).split())
            break
        chunk = tail + chunk
        last_space = chunk.rfind(b" ")
        last_nl = chunk.rfind(b"\n")
        cut = max(last_space, last_nl)
        if cut == -1:
            tail = chunk
            continue
        counts.update(chunk[:cut].translate(TABLE).split())
        tail = chunk[cut+1:]
    top10 = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))[:10]
    sys.stdout.write("".join(f"{w.decode()} {c}\n" for w, c in top10))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
